title: Reliable Pods sign-in and execution readiness
goal: Implement the approved startup mock and separate authentication from execution compatibility.
summary: Owner authorized publication and installation. Next: reconcile native issue and report receipts, publish and merge the reviewed change, run the deployment gate, then install and verify the owner build from clean merged source.

approval.reference: Dann mach die Installation und Veröffentlichung mit Opus 5.5
approval.scope: Publish the reviewed code and evidence through the canonical native PR and Reports, merge after required checks, and install and verify the supported keychain-free owner build. Preserve owner credentials and rollback. This is not a public downloadable Developer-ID release.

milestones.title: Implement real startup and sign-in states
milestones.goal: Connect the approved Vue UI to authenticated state, errors and bounded retry without starting Pods.
acceptance: Show only DDISA sign-in until authentication succeeds.
Expose meaningful errors, cancellation, expiry and effective retry; never load indefinitely.
Retain diagnosis and update access while execution is unavailable.

milestones.title: Separate execution compatibility
milestones.goal: Replace the exact kernel check with a maintained policy enforced at every execution entry.
acceptance: Unknown/unsupported systems cannot execute Pods; owner sign-in remains reachable.
Do not mark macOS 27 verified without real allowed/denied packaged boundary tests.
Preserve sandbox, grants, owner credentials and existing scheduled identity behavior.

milestones.title: Verify and prepare native review
milestones.goal: Run scoped UI, state-machine and native boundary checks, then the affected gate and review.
acceptance: Production CSS browser states/transitions and narrow layouts pass.
Failure, retry, unsupported execution and normal paths are covered; lint/typecheck/build and affected unit gate pass.
Prepare a native issue-linked PR when the canonical forge is reachable; do not modify the installed owner app.

milestones.title: Publish and install the owner build
milestones.goal: Deliver the reviewed change through the canonical forge and install clean merged source with the supported owner installer.
acceptance: Publish the native issue-linked PR and evidence, merge after the required local checks.
Pass the deployment gate; verify relay compatibility, idle installation, paired rollback and unchanged configuration.
Verify the installed source, worker and owner sign-in state; repeat installation unchanged without additional effects.

sections.title: Scope and current constraints
sections.body: Worktree: openape-monorepo.worktrees/pods-startup-recovery, cached canonical main d49dfd7a67ffe78b1e4756097da6eb33e6761486. DNS currently prevents canonical fetch and issue creation; reuse idempotency key pods-startup-recovery-20261023 and reconcile before retry. The mock is in the separate pods-startup-mock checkout. No service restart, owner login, credential changes, signing, deployment, gate bypass or unrelated refactor. Production integration uses existing Options API, styles and English/German i18n. Parent owns this plan and publication; Opus owns implementation and tests.

sections.title: Original implementation approval
sections.body: Revision 1 was approved by Patrick Hofmann on 2026-10-23 with: “Passt. Dann lass opus 5.5 das alles implementieren. Mock schaut super aus”. Owner approved the preceding nine-state mock and proposal to separate authentication/diagnostics/update access from Pod execution readiness, replace exact kernel equality with a maintained compatibility policy, and verify new macOS versions. This plan records that approved scope; production installation/signing is not claimed.
